entries.name: Remote Desktop Commander
entries.inputContract: Authorized Windows endpoint command request with a reviewer-provided nonce or probe packet.
entries.outputContract: Sanitized proof that the Windows endpoint accepted the request and returned a bounded reply.
entries.notes: Historical parent evidence only; no live endpoint control is exposed in this static suite.

entries.name: Windows / WSL
entries.inputContract: Windows-to-Ubuntu-to-Windows roundtrip probe packet with bounded request and response digests.
entries.outputContract: Sanitized receipt confirming the roundtrip and preserving request and response SHA-256 values.
entries.notes: Captured as a historical sanitized receipt without private device identifiers or local paths.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.inputContract: Repository branch or file metadata request through the authenticated GitHub transport layer.
entries.outputContract: Repository-visible branch metadata or connector reply evidence for the current repository.
entries.notes: The public source branch transport probe is recorded as parent evidence only.

entries.name: GitHub CLI
entries.inputContract: Authenticated WD to GitHub command targeting a bounded repository write or metadata exchange.
entries.outputContract: Commit identifiers plus a sanitized WD reply digest for reviewer confirmation.
entries.notes: Historical authenticated write evidence is recorded without exposing credentials or raw console history.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.inputContract: Issue or pull-request implementation request constrained to this repository branch.
entries.outputContract: Repository changes and local test artifacts on the active pull request branch.
entries.notes: Execution is real but still subject to independent review; the suite does not claim merge or deployment.

entries.name: Codex CLI 0.153.4
entries.inputContract: Authenticated WD Codex session plus repository command request.
entries.outputContract: Session metadata or an explicit policy block stating that repository access was rejected.
entries.notes: A new model session ran, but repository access was denied by policy and produced zero file reads or test execution.

entries.name: smarts.bio
entries.inputContract: Tool listing or execution request through the smarts.bio interface.
entries.outputContract: Either a user-login requirement or a bounded execution receipt after authentication.
entries.notes: The current public probe stopped at the login gate, so no tool run is claimed.

entries.name: BioNeMo Agent Toolkit
entries.inputContract: Official toolkit documentation review or installed-skill discovery request.
entries.outputContract: Documentation findings or skill catalogue evidence, not a live NIM/model/GPU execution.
entries.notes: Docs were inspected only; no NIM endpoint, model inference, or GPU job was executed.

entries.name: NCBI Datasets
entries.inputContract: Recorded177 assembly panel requests with explicit versioning, hashes, and the no-Enterococcus scope rule.
entries.outputContract: Downloaded assembly bundles and metadata manifests for later review.
entries.notes: This suite declares the contract only and does not download any genomes.

entries.name: GToTree
entries.inputContract: Proteomes or genome annotations plus conserved single-copy marker settings.
entries.outputContract: Per-family marker selections that stay independent from R-M annotations.
entries.notes: Declared only; no tree or marker output is fabricated here.

entries.name: HMMER
entries.inputContract: Protein sequences and marker HMM profiles.
entries.outputContract: Profile hits supporting conserved single-copy marker family selection.
entries.notes: Declared only; no hidden execution is claimed.

entries.name: MAFFT
entries.inputContract: Per-family protein sequence sets produced from the conserved marker stage.
entries.outputContract: Separate alignment files for each marker family.
entries.notes: Alignments stay separate and are never collapsed into a fabricated one-step result.

entries.name: trimAl
entries.inputContract: Per-family alignments with explicit trimming settings.
entries.outputContract: Trimmed alignments that remain versioned before concatenation.
entries.notes: Declared only; no trimmed data are included in this public repository.

entries.name: IQ-TREE
entries.inputContract: Concatenated conserved single-copy marker alignments with explicit model-selection parameters.
entries.outputContract: Host-tree inference artifacts kept separate from R-M annotations.
entries.notes: No full host tree exists in this repository.

entries.name: DefenseFinder
entries.inputContract: Ordered per-replicon protein and coordinate input for defense-system detection.
entries.outputContract: Candidate loci that require human REBASE and primary-paper review.
entries.notes: Predicted systems are not experimental restriction-activity proof.

entries.name: REBASE
entries.inputContract: Candidate R-M loci or enzymes identified during ordered per-replicon review.
entries.outputContract: Reference annotations for the manual locus-review packet.
entries.notes: Declared only; no reviewed locus packet is bundled here.

entries.name: Geneious
entries.inputContract: Local sequence-review workspace inputs for human inspection.
entries.outputContract: Private reviewer workspace artifacts, not public automation output.
entries.notes: Optional and unprobed in this repository.

entries.name: iTOL
entries.inputContract: Verified host tree plus reviewed Type I, II/IIG, III, and IV ring annotations.
entries.outputContract: Four-ring visualization assets for publication or review.
entries.notes: Declared only; no ring output is fabricated.

entries.name: Genomic Intelligence
entries.inputContract: External genomics-analysis request with explicit reviewer approval.
entries.outputContract: External evidence packet requiring manual verification before reuse.
entries.notes: Optional and intentionally unprobed here.

entries.name: native ChatGPT Sites
entries.inputContract: Native ChatGPT Site manifest or deployment receipt lookup.
entries.outputContract: An actual native deployment receipt, if one ever exists.
entries.notes: No native deployment receipt exists, and GitHub Pages source must not be relabeled as a native ChatGPT Site.
